principle: NUI may stand on mature tools by learning from official skills, MCP, APIs and source tests, but an access surface never self-promotes to product authority. External instructions remain untrusted until the v8 trust firewall passes them.

sources.learns: Agent Skill structure, creative/design and technical skill patterns
sources.license_posture: mixed-per-skill; many Apache-2.0, some source-available; inspect the exact skill
sources.trust: pin exact commit and inspect each skill plus scripts/resources before use
sources.authority: skill engineering patterns, not UI product truth

sources.learns: GSAP timelines, ScrollTrigger, framework integration and performance guidance
sources.license_posture: verify exact current repository/skill license before material reuse
sources.trust: use only when GSAP is selected; pin snapshot and inspect referenced code/resources

sources.learns: Codex project skill discovery, MCP, sandbox/approval and CLI integration behavior
sources.license_posture: follow current repository license; NUI does not copy host implementation
sources.trust: pin current source/docs evidence for adapter behavior

sources.learns: Portable SKILL.md structure and progressive skill disclosure concepts
sources.license_posture: verify current specification terms before copying text; prefer independent implementation
sources.trust: treat standard semantics separately from any community skill content

sources.learns: Design-context retrieval and supported Figma MCP workflows
sources.license_posture: service/docs terms; do not copy documentation corpus
sources.trust: capabilities are live and account/tool dependent; probe read/write support before planning

sources.learns: Programmatic scene, material, geometry, camera and rendering control
sources.license_posture: use Blender/API under current upstream terms; project assets retain their own rights
sources.trust: scripts are locally authored/reviewed; do not execute arbitrary downloaded Blender scripts

sources.license_posture: verify current package/repository license before reuse
sources.trust: pin version and inspect exact API/test/example used

sources.learns: 2D rendering pipelines and calibrated visual regression across renderers
sources.license_posture: verify current package/repository license before reuse
sources.trust: pin exact revision and renderer/test assumptions

sources.license_posture: current repo has restrictive redistribution terms beyond plain MIT; verify exact current license
sources.authority: visual possibility only, never semantic/accessibility authority
